expected_structural_delta: One helper and one leftover-sweep function in the engine, a few lines in github_remove_runner, a multi-pass loop in the reaper. No new daemon, setting or store.
minimum_design: One small crf_stage_aside helper (same-filesystem rename with symlink, mount and device guards) used by github_remove_runner for docker/<slot> and pooled work/<slot>; reuse the existing docker-evicted reaper and work trash sweep; reaper loops until empty; lifecycle tick restarts it for leftovers. Unsafe cases keep the in-place delete.
outcome: Removing a runner with its storage no longer holds the fleet lock for a large delete: slot Docker stores and pooled workspaces are moved aside and deleted in the background, so a Start that reaps many dead slots finishes in seconds.

reuse_decisions.name: layer_integrity_reap_evicted and docker-evicted
reuse_decisions.rationale: Existing background reaper for moved-aside Docker stores.

reuse_decisions.name: github_work_trash_sweep_async and work/.trash
reuse_decisions.rationale: Existing background sweep for moved-aside workspaces.
